arguments.value: This agreement creates a strategic alliance between Cool Technologies and Veteran Technology Group to refer clients to each other and separately market and perform their own services. Each company keeps control of its own work, billing terms, staffing, client relationships, and intellectual property, unless they agree otherwise in writing. They must include reference to the other company in contracts and proposals for referred work, and can bill either the client directly or the other company depending on the arrangement. The agreement lasts at least five years, renews automatically for one-year periods unless cancelled, and can also be ended earlier by mutual agreement or 60 days’ written notice. Both sides must keep shared information confidential, may not hire or solicit each other’s personnel for six months after the agreement ends, and must indemnify each other for losses caused by their own negligence or misconduct. It is governed by Missouri law.
